description.en: Adds a party member silently (no message/jingle), setting up their position lock, avatar enable/lock flags, and optionally their level, via CMND_ADD_PARTY and its follow-up CMND_SET_*_FLAG calls. Does nothing extra if CMND_ADD_PARTY fails (returns a non-positive handle).
Param ID of the character to add to the party.
Whether to lock the member's position slot.
Whether to enable the member's avatar.
Whether to lock the member's avatar.
Optional level to set for the new member (defaults to -1, meaning don't change it).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Add a party member silently, without a message or jingle
AddParty("para_cp0008", true, false, false);
